answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond in an escrow vault before it may transact. Honest agents reclaim it; any caught colluding is slashed. Because a sybil swarm is really one reef of fake nodes sharing a controller, every identity needs its own deposit up front, so spinning up N agents costs N bonds, not one. That capital is as hard to counterfeit as quartz, turning mass identity creation from free into economically ruinous.
